Definition: Jechdijah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehdeiah is the name of two Israelites, a Levite of the sons of Shubael in the courses of the temple, and the Meronothite who was over David's asses. One served at the altar, the other kept the king's herds.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God honours the Levite and the herdsman alike, and Jehdeiah's two lives are both in His book.
